text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, early in the afternoon—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey Kris S! Fine!
Won't you climb a mountain with me!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mountain climbing? Oh, that sounds like fun!
If you don't mind me, I'd love to accompany you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I don't mind—but.
Why—us—?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Well, the mountain I'm aiming for seems pretty tough. I need some reliable comrades.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: So here's the deal. I want Kris S as the helmsman, and Fine as the recorder.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Get your gear ready early! We set out on our mountain expedition tomorrow morning!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... darn it!
What an incline! Does this go all the way to the summit?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—No need—to rush. Schedule...
No delay—this pace is optimal—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
——Water.
—Drink.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Hahaha! Just as I thought, asking you along was the right call! Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
How about over there, Photographer!
Getting some great shots?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yep! I'm taking tons of voyage records! I've snapped so many lovely flowers already!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, I have to record our captain too! Fufu, look this way please~

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Whoa, make it look cool, okay? —Cheese!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Hell yeah, we made it!
We're hereeee! We did it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Mission Accomplished—
—Duty—fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Wow, what an incredible view! Could this scenery be what you wanted to see, Tap?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it wasn't me who wanted to see it.
—There's someone I wanted to show it to.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...She loved mountain climbing. Whenever she had a break, she'd head right for the mountains—she used to talk so happily about becoming a mountaineer in the future.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: But she got injured on a mountain... Fortunately, the wound fully healed. Nothing's wrong with her body anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What didn't heal was her heart. Terrified of nature—she couldn't love the mountains after that.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: But! When she was climbing, she was shining! Giving up on your dream over a single wound just ain't right!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: That's why—I came here. To remind her what climbing mountains is really all about.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Fine. Will you give me the photos from our way up? With those—I'm gonna show her.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: That mountains are awesome! And tell her, "You were the one who taught me that!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! Then let's take a group photo together with the summit view in the background.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Sounds great! Kris S, you too! Give us your biggest smile!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ............—Will—attempt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking through the academy grounds on a day off, I spotted horse girls happily talking.

text_block_list.name: Mountain-Loving Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Hey Tap, which mountain should we climb next? We've climbed pretty much all the nearby ones, so let's go on an expedition and aim for somewhere even higher next time!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Whew! Look who's talking big! You're completely unrecognizable from when you hated mountains and were moping around!

text_block_list.name: Mountain-Loving Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! I'll never say I won't climb mountains again. Because it's just so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Mountain-Loving Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Seriously, thanks so much for back then, Tap...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hey now—come on, don't be so formal. All I did was go for a hike with some dependable pals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking through the academy grounds on a day off, I spotted horse girls deep in conversation.

text_block_list.name: Mountain-Loving Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Tap, thanks for the LANE message... The photos were amazing! It was like they were speaking to me, showing how wonderful mountains really are—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Right? The recorder had some serious skills. Asking Fine was totally the right call!

text_block_list.name: Mountain-Climbing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...And so...
Um, if you don't mind...

text_block_list.name: Mountain-Climbing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Would you like to climb a mountain with me next time...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Of course. That's what I was waiting to hear!
Come on, let's head out on a brand-new adventure!
